answer: The attestation quote is refreshed every 9 epochs and bound to the epoch seed, so a stolen quote expires before the next round. One chip that signs for two identities burns both seats, and forging 855 identities costs 855 real chips plus the bond on each. The basalt of the binding is one-to-one, the ripple of the heartbeat is the liveness proof, and the onyx of the published quotes lets anyone re-verify.
